{
  "name": "status-band",
  "version": "0.2.2",
  "description": "Opinionated framed status band for Claude Code with git, model, context, and the branch's PR review state",
  "author": {
    "name": "Nikita Nemirovsky",
    "url": "https://github.com/nnemirovsky"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/nnemirovsky/cc-status-band",
  "repository": "https://github.com/nnemirovsky/cc-status-band",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/nnemirovsky/cc-status-band#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/nnemirovsky/cc-status-band/issues",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "statusline",
    "status-line",
    "footer",
    "pull-request",
    "github",
    "git",
    "mod",
    "function-hooks"
  ],
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/nnemirovsky/cc-status-band/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "nerdFont": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Nerd Font glyphs",
      "description": "Draw the PR and CI marks as GitHub octicons from a Nerd Font instead of plain Unicode",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
